topic: Server infrastructure changes and data migration
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on reconfiguring server resources. A new 700GB SSD disk, named 'dev', was requested for the Norris machine. The plan involves removing shards and designating the Norris machine as a development server. Servers 05 and 06 will be repurposed as replicas for production and staging environments. Server 01-03 are slated to be shut down. Data migration tasks include collecting `raw_devices_seen` and `device_session` data onto the new 'dev' disk.
decisions: A 700GB SSD named 'dev' will be added to the Norris machine.
The Norris machine will function as a development server, replacing shards.
Servers 05 and 06 will serve as replicas for production and staging environments.
Servers 01-03 are scheduled to be powered down.
The new 'dev' disk is intended solely for data storage.
action_items: Configure the new dev disk location (e.g., /data/dev).
